description.value: A group campground within Manning Provincial Park on Highway 3, set among Cascade Mountain forests with access to the park's lakes, trails, and summer naturalist programs. Designed for groups rather than individual parties, so solo tourers should confirm site availability before planning a stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for manningpark.com/camping confirms Lone Duck is among Manning Park's campgrounds (listed as 'LONE DUCK ONE' and 'LONE DUCK TWO' in the campground roster), operated under BC Parks. The website states that all Manning Park camping reservations except Skyview must be made through BCParks.ca, directly confirming reservations are accepted for Lone Duck. No Lone Duck-specific amenity details are described on the website, so most optional amenities remain null; OSM tags likewise provide no amenity detail beyond the camp_site tag and operator.
concerns: OSM names this record 'Lone Duck Group Campground' but the website lists two distinct entries—'LONE DUCK ONE' and 'LONE DUCK TWO'—with no 'group campground' designation; the OSM record may conflate both or use an unofficial name.
No Lone Duck-specific amenity information is provided on the website; details apply to the broader Manning Park resort area and other named campgrounds (e.g., Skyview, Lightning Lake).

Phone (1-604-668-5922) and address (7500 HWY #3) are sourced from Manning Park Resort's general contact info on the website; OSM has no phone or address for this specific campground, so these cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Lone Duck Group Campground is a legitimate BC Parks campsite within Manning Provincial Park on the Highway 3 cycling corridor. Despite being group-designated, it serves touring cycling groups and belongs in a BC cycling tourism directory.
